data.ruling: The refutation stands. The drop's main reason is that the data sheet states only the source pull-up currents, so detection of Default, 1.5 A and 3.0 A at the sink is not shown. That premise is false. PTN5110 Rev. 1.6 (3 April 2020), Table 12, page 38, states two sink-mode detection thresholds next to the Ipullup rows. VTUS, "Standard current mode detection threshold, Sink mode", is 0.61 / 0.66 / 0.70 V (minimum / typical / maximum). VTUM, "Medium current mode detection threshold, Sink mode", is 1.16 / 1.23 / 1.31 V. Section 1 also says the part implements the Type-C CC analog portion, "Rd/Rp/Ra detection". The two thresholds split the CC voltage at the sink into three bands: below VTUS, between VTUS and VTUM, and above VTUM. That is a separate band for each of Default, 1.5 A and 3.0 A. So the verifier's further point that no 3.0 A sink threshold is stated is wrong too: VTUM is the boundary to the 3.0 A band. The band reading rests on the data sheet's labels only; the USB Type-C specification is not in the tree and was not read. The register coding (CC_STATUS) is deferred to the TCPC (Type-C Port Controller) specification [3] and the programming guide [5]. Neither was read, so how firmware reads the level is not read. That does not bring back the stated premise. None of the drop's "Also" items is a rule failure. JLCPCB stock is 600 with a presale count of 581. That clears the S4 gate: the need is 5 boards × 1 placement, so the gate is the floor of 50. The NXP page lists the status as Active, which passes S5. Its schema availability "BackOrder" is not a lifecycle status. A price of 9.7653 a unit and the need for a TCPM (Type-C Port Manager) stack are ranking factors, not requirement or sourcing failures. The refutation concerns this function's requirement, the input limit's advertisement detection, so its scope is function.

Table 12 "USB PD and Type-C AC/DC characteristics", page 37: Ipullup (current source for Source pull-up indication) Default 64/80/96 uA, 1.5 A 166/180/194 uA, 3 A 314/330/346 uA. Rpulldn 4.6/5.1/5.6 kOhm. VCLAMPH 0.85 to 2.18 V and VCLAMPM 0.45 to 1.25 V, both "Sink mode; VDD = 0, VBUS = 0". Table 12 continued, page 38: VCLAMPL 0.25 to 1.25 V. VTUM "Medium current mode detection threshold", Sink mode, 1.16/1.23/1.31 V. VTUS "Standard current mode detection threshold", Sink mode, 0.61/0.66/0.70 V. VTURa 0.15/0.2/0.25 V, Sink mode. Line 19 of the text: "implements Type-C CC analog portion (i.e Rd/Rp/Ra detection, Rd/Rp indication)".
